description: Short messages at the bottom (Android AppSnackbarHost / iOS snackbar surface): colour of the 1.5 dp/pt border and leading symbol per kind x price-colour scheme x accent (null = without accent) x dark x highContrast, as RGB hex (null = INFO: no coloured border, no symbol). SUCCESS = the scheme's rising colour without swap (never the swapped colour: success is not a price direction), ERROR = the app error colour (light B13419, dark FF5833, unchanged in high contrast), but with a colour-vision scheme (BLUE_ORANGE, CALM_COLOR_VISION) the scheme's falling colour without swap. Derived from price_colors.json (inverted = false); the 'Swap colours' setting never changes these values.
